title: Email: Fw: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation

content.subject: Fw: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, April 1, 2016 7:39 AM
To: Caryn Leeds <leeds@sunshinesachs.com>; Annick Oppenheim <oppenheim@sunshinesachs.com>
Subject: Re: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation 
 
Let me know when you get them!

From: Caryn Leeds <leeds@sunshinesachs.com>
Sent: Thursday, March 31, 2016 5:59 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony; Annick Oppenheim
Subject: RE: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation 
 
Hi Anthony,
We hear we’re getting them around 8pm tonight & will send you the link asap!

From: Fenech, Anthony [mailto:afenech@freepress.com] 
Sent: Thursday, March 31, 2016 5:48 PM
To: Caryn Leeds <leeds@sunshinesachs.com>; Annick Oppenheim <oppenheim@sunshinesachs.com>
Subject: Re: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation

From: Caryn Leeds <leeds@sunshinesachs.com>
Sent: Thursday, March 31, 2016 4:09 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony; Annick Oppenheim
Subject: Re: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation
Yup, definitely! We are awaiting the pics from the photographer and will get them to you asap.
Thanks so much for covering the event!

From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Thursday, March 31, 2016 4:08 PM
To: Annick Oppenheim
Cc: Caryn Leeds
Subject: Re: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation

Just e-mailing to see if you could make sure that I get the press release with photos from today's event. Writing something up for our website that will go on USA Today and they would like photos. I don't think Christie has my e-mail address.

From: Annick Oppenheim <oppenheim@sunshinesachs.com>
Sent: Wednesday, March 30, 2016 2:30 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Caryn Leeds
Subject: GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT Coverage confirmation
Please be advised you are confirmed to cover the GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT, hosted by Kate Upton, tomorrow, Wednesday, March 31st.
NOTE: PRESS CHECK-IN WILL BE AT A TABLE IN HANGAR #2, SHOWN ON ATTACHED MAP.
Onsite Media Contacts:                 Paula Creamer, Cell: 863-559-2944
Note: Due to time constraints, interviews will likely need to be kept to one to two questions each.  As discussed, you and your family will have the opportunity to pose for photos with Kate
Please let us know if you have any questions. Thank you!
o 212.691.2800 | c 310.756.5146 | 136 Madison Ave. 17th Floor. New York, NY 10016
